meta.title: Labwise — understand your lab report
meta.description: Upload a lab report or prescription and get a calm, plain-language explanation, questions to ask, and which kind of doctor to see.

common.somethingWrongBody: That didn't work. Your data is safe — please try again.
common.offlineBody: Check your connection. Anything you've saved is still here.

marker.noRange: No reference range found on your report.
marker.reasonsHigh: Common reasons it can be high
marker.reasonsLow: Common reasons it can be low
marker.reasonsNote: These are general reasons, not a diagnosis. Your doctor will look at the whole picture.

upload.dropBody: A PDF, or clear photos of each page. Up to 10 pages.
upload.limits: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC · up to 20 MB

trends.bandNote: Shaded band is your lab's range

disclaimer.short: Labwise explains reports. It doesn't diagnose or replace a doctor.
